scope: DESI DR1 BGS redshift-resolved odd-sector matched-filter deployment; not yet an absolute DESI wake constraint.
interpretation: The real DESI DR1 odd sector is statistically ordinary under the permutation control. The apparent ~1.9 sigma coefficient in the minimal Doppler+wake model is not robust to conservative per-redshift odd nuisance freedom; the conservative wake coefficient is 0.14 sigma. The redshift-resolved analysis removes the pathological covariance and near-perfect wake-Doppler degeneracy of the first pilot.
remaining_nature_astronomy_upgrade: Forward-convolve the custom odd templates through the estimator/window and validate covariance/systematics with the public BGS EZmock and AbacusSummit mock catalogs using the same luminosity split.
